models.name: activity-separate-deployment
models.title: Separate target-authorized deployment
models.trigger: Actor separately requests deployment of an identified artifact/revision to an intended target.
models.preconditions: Target authority/approval, compatible data/recovery conditions and exact artifact/revision are explicit; successful build alone is insufficient.
models.postcondition: Only independently permitted intended target effects are attempted; actual confirmed, failed or unknown target outcome is retained.
models.exceptions: Missing target approval, stale artifact/revision or unsuitable conditions deny deployment. An unknown outcome is reconciled before further consequential action.
models.gate: Q-D23 target/approval/execution feasibility remains gated; no target or production change is created by this analysis.
models.meaning: Target deployment is a separate requested goal from workflow success, merge, tag or release.
models.limits: No live deployment or automatic rollback is authorized. Recovery or retry must be separately eligible for actual current target state.

models.name: activity-policy-admission-evidence
models.title: Effective policy, file admission or restricted evidence
models.trigger: Actor requests one permitted policy, file-admission or evidence operation. Admission refines supporting file paths in the existing scenarios rather than allocating a new external use case.
models.preconditions: Current role/resource/action authority, effective policy and actual content/usage/reference context are identified; administrative authority differs from upload authority.
models.postcondition: Actual effective policy, usable admitted resource or permitted bounded evidence is reported for the requested operation only.
models.exceptions: Denied operations expose no restricted data. Failed persistence/processing/cleanup does not claim effective settings, usable content or freed capacity; lower limit does not silently delete history.
models.gate: Q-D24 numerical values/pools/concurrency and Q-D27 applicability remain proposals; actual capacity is not inferred from idle free disk.
models.meaning: Policy administration, upload and evidence access are separate powers and alternative goals. A lower quota is not a cleanup instruction.
models.limits: Concurrent admissions require a reviewed current capacity contract, not a pre-check promise. Cleanup eligibility and confirmed reclamation remain distinct in SM-M16.

models.name: activity-isolated-recovery-assessment
models.title: Conditional isolated restore and usability assessment
models.trigger: Operator identifies a loss/recovery scenario and requests an explicitly authorized isolated drill.
models.preconditions: Identified protected recovery source, required artifacts/configuration, defined coverage/targets, suitable isolation and operator authority must actually exist for a later drill.
models.postcondition: Actual findings identify covered/restored information, integrity, safe current access, external-state disposition and measured target comparison; no success is assumed before evidence.
models.exceptions: No authority/source/safe target blocks the drill. Missing/corrupt/inconsistent material or missed targets remain failed/incomplete. Revisit only under isolated authorized recovery policy.
models.gate: Backups are not configured. Q-D26 source/coverage/targets/restore proof and Q-D27 operating evidence remain open; this is not execution authorization.
models.meaning: Restored bytes are only input to usability/access/external-state assessment. Repeated drills keep distinguishable evidence.
models.limits: Backups are not configured, so the current real path stops at the prerequisite gate. No live overwrite, old-grant resurrection or external replay is authorized.

models.name: activity-operation-result-classification
models.title: Reusable actual operation-result classification
models.trigger: An intended operation has a result or missing confirmation requiring classification.
models.preconditions: Exact intended operation context and permitted observation scope are identified.
models.postcondition: Only evidence-supported confirmed, pending, failed, partial or unknown effects are reported.
models.exceptions: Uncertain effect is not inferred failure, success or unchanged state; no blind retry.
models.gate: Classification refines existing failure semantics; no retry/transaction mechanism selected.
models.meaning: Called by workflows after an attempted consequential action; each caller resumes/returns according to its actual domain result. This is a reusable analysis subactivity, not a selected runtime service.
models.limits: Definite failure may include known effects and is not universal rollback. An unknown result requires same-operation reconciliation; retry is a separate authorized action. When context cannot be established, do not expose protected evidence or claim an attributed result.
